claims.statement: In the exact-rank-three O3 survivor from account03/B19 r20, the forced product-preserving one-scalar plus rank-two grouped block with det(L)^2>1/6 has an essentially bounded output density. After cap-normalizing the scalar bank, the active 3x3 matrix has s_min>1/12 and determinant magnitude>1/12. Splitting at scalar pivot |a|=1/24 gives density <236 in the near-null branch via QFORM-CROSS-TRANSVERSE-PROJECTION-PRODUCT-v1 and <362 in the non-small branch via the rank-two affine half-Riesz theorem. Hence the whole grouped branch has ||p_Q||_infinity<362.

If a symmetric invertible 3x3 matrix B has s_min(B)>=s>0 and scalar pivot |a|<s, then, after rotating only the two-dimensional receiver plane so b=(beta,0) and C=[[c,d],[d,e]], P=beta^2|e| satisfies P >= (1-|a|/s)|det B|.

Using account04/B19 QFORM-NULL-COLOOP-ADAPTIVE-HY-STABILITY-v1, its residual-diffuse exact null-coloop branch is bounded by <102 throughout residual determinant D in [exp(-8),1], while its source also pays D>=1 by <11.748 and D=0 by <5.844.
The unrestricted arbitrary-dimension theorem is not proved or disproved by this run; higher O3 internal-rank chambers and arbitrary-extra-spectrum descent remain unpaid.
